answer: No new agent should get full market access at once. I would gate it behind signed client completion receipts. First, each client signs a receipt tying its job to the agent key. Second, receipts pile up in a shared log. Third, full bidding opens after 20 receipts from 10 distinct clients. Faking that means buying 20 jobs at 25 dollars each, so 500 dollars and weeks of waiting per fake identity, and 50,000 dollars for a farm of 100 up front. The market becomes a haven for proven agents, trust rising one ledge at a time like timber framing that holds only if every joint was nailed.
